faq.a: Computer science/IT graduates, freshers with programming aptitude, SAP functional consultants wanting technical skills, and existing ABAP developers upgrading to S/4HANA and CDS/RAP.

faq.q: How long is the SAP ABAP training?
faq.a: The core program typically runs 6 to 8 weeks with instructor-led sessions, hands-on labs and project work, depending on batch mode and pace.

faq.q: Is the SAP ABAP training available online and classroom?
faq.a: Yes. Placeonix offers both instructor-led classroom training in Hyderabad and live online sessions.

faq.q: Will I get access to a real SAP system?
faq.a: Yes. Practical work is done on a live S/4HANA system using Eclipse ADT so you gain hands-on experience writing and testing real ABAP, CDS and RAP code.

faq.q: What topics are covered in the curriculum?
faq.a: ABAP fundamentals (syntax, data types, internal tables, modularization), object-oriented ABAP, CDS views with annotations and associations, AMDP, an introduction to RAP, RICEF objects, and Eclipse/ADT tooling with abapGit.

faq.q: Which tools and technologies will I use?
faq.a: Eclipse ADT, SAP GUI, SE80, ABAP Cloud, CDS Views, AMDP, RAP, abapGit, Fiori Elements and OData on an S/4HANA system.

faq.q: Are there hands-on projects?
faq.a: Yes. You build a CDS-based reporting app, a RAP-based business object, and a RICEF development scenario, so you finish with portfolio-ready work.

faq.a: The curriculum is aligned with the SAP Certified Development Associate - ABAP for SAP HANA path and introduces concepts used in the ABAP with RAP certification track. Trainers provide guidance and practice questions for the official SAP exams.

faq.q: What job roles can I target after this course?
faq.a: SAP ABAP Developer, SAP ABAP/CDS Developer, ABAP/RAP Consultant, SAP Technical Consultant and S/4HANA Technical Analyst roles.

faq.q: Is SAP ABAP still in demand?
faq.a: Yes. S/4HANA migrations need ABAP developers who can write clean-core compliant code, the shift to CDS/RAP is creating demand for modern ABAP skills, and the huge installed base of SAP systems needs ongoing maintenance and enhancement.

faq.q: What is the batch size?
faq.a: Batches are kept small (maximum 30) so every learner gets individual attention and direct trainer feedback.

faq.q: Can working professionals join?
faq.a: Yes. Weekend and evening batches are available so working professionals can upskill without a career break.

faq.a: Yes. You receive a Placeonix course completion certificate, and you are guided toward the official SAP certification which is issued by SAP.

faq.a: RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model) is the modern, SAP-recommended programming model built using CDS and ABAP, while classic ABAP includes RICEF development and older techniques. RAP is the future-facing approach, and we teach it in depth in our dedicated SAP RAP course.

faq.q: What is SAP RAP?

faq.a: Managed Business Objects let the RAP framework generate standard create/update/delete persistence logic automatically, while unmanaged Business Objects require you to implement all persistence logic yourself, typically for complex or legacy-integrated scenarios.
